Sonargaon Textiles Limited owns and operates a textile spinning mill in Bangladesh. It manufactures and sells cotton yarn of various counts for knitting and weaving. Sonargaon Textiles Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
